[illegible, ~3 letters] Pahel Ch. Mittere, emittere, dimittere, ejicere, projicere.
שגרין Ch. ויהון שגרין Et erunt calidi, & calefient, ut Regia habent, Ezech.39.9.

שנש [illegible, ~3 letters] Syriac. Turbare, perturbare, conturbare. Pahel שנש Chald. & Syr. Turbare, conturbare, turbas, tumultum, strepitum excitare, tumultuari, strepere, Ithpeh. אשתנש [illegible, ~3 letters] vel Ithpah. אשתנש & אשתנשנ Turbari, conturbari, commoveri, concuti: tumultuari, fremere, strepere.

שגושא, שגישיא, שגושא Chald. & Syriac. Turbatio, Conturbatio, Strepitus, Tumultus, Tumultuatio, Seditio: Item Murmurator, Susurro, adjective, Proverbior. 18.8. & 26.22. pro quo forte ad formam Syram rectius legeretur שגושא: Hebraice נרגן. Plural. Syriac. [illegible, ~3 letters] Tumultus. Lucæ 21.9.
שגושתא Ch. Idem, Esth. 6.1. in T.scc.

שרא שדי Chald. & Syriac. Jecit, abjecit, dejecit, ejecit, projecit, præcipitavit: Hinc Ch. significat quoque Jecit sagittam, jaculatus, ejaculatus est, jaculis petiit vel cofecit: Item fudit, effudit, profudit, quomodo convenit cū אשר. Pahel שרא שדי Idē.
